title: St. Moritz Catalog Curation - Corviglia and Celerina scope correction
summary: Rebuilds PR #19 on current main and corrects the Upper Engadin graph around Corviglia / Piz Nair. St. Moritz is split into Dorf, Bad and Suvretta stay bases, Celerina is added as a separate stay destination and base, and each receives an explicit source-backed feeder relationship. Corviglia retains one operating owner with official terrain metrics and map; the broader disconnected Upper Engadin pass context is represented without inventing a connected terrain domain. Missing Upper Engadin destinations and ski-area owners are explicitly deferred to the catalog-curation backlog.
